title: SESI-SP opens registrations for 2027: dates and rules
seoTitle: SESI-SP opens registrations for 2027: dates and rules
subtitle: The SESI-SP education network has already released the full calendar for the selection process.
excerpt: Registrations for the 2027 school year are now open online. Check the dates, periods for beneficiaries and non-beneficiaries, and how the selection works.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Families planning to enroll their children in the SESI-SP network in 2027 can now get organized. The registration calendar has been released and includes two distinct periods: one for industry beneficiaries and another for the general public.

Industry Beneficiary Period

For legal dependents of employees from companies contributing to SESI-SP, registration begins at 8 AM on October 6th and closes at 4 PM on October 15th. During this interval, all units with available spots for this group are open for registration.

General Public Period

For non-beneficiaries, the registration process runs from 8 AM on October 19th to 4 PM on October 21st. However, registration will only be open in schools and for grades where vacancies remain after accommodating beneficiaries.

How the Selection Works

For Early Childhood Education and the 1st year of Elementary School, selection occurs via electronic lottery, scheduled for October 27th, at 9 AM, at the school where the candidate registered. If the number of applicants exceeds the number of available spots, the lottery will determine who is admitted.

For other school years – from the 2nd year of Elementary School to the 2nd year of High School – selection is by examination. Assessments are applied between November 6th and 12th, on dates and times defined by each unit. Candidates who do not attend the exam lose the right to continue in the process.

Online Registrations Only

All registrations are done exclusively online, at the website sesisp.org.br. There is no possibility of in-person registration. Guardians must consult the official notice and information before registering, to check requirements, documentation, and other rules.

Involved Units

The SESI-SP network has 137 educational units distributed throughout the State of São Paulo. Among those opening registrations in 2027 are units in Suzano, Mogi das Cruzes, Ferraz de Vasconcelos, and Guarulhos. Each unit has an address and contact number, such as CE 081 in Suzano (av. Doutor Odilon de Souza, 431) and CE 113 in Mogi das Cruzes (rua Coronel Cardoso de Siqueira, 3050).

Recommendations for Guardians

  • Verify at the time of registration if the desired unit and grade have an open process.
  • Do not leave registration until the last minute, as the periods have defined start and end times.
  • Monitor the chosen school's announcements to know the date and time of the exam, if applicable.

With information from Jornal Terceira Visão, Hoje Diário.
